title: Alfonso Fanjul Jr., Cuban American Sugar Baron, Dies at 89

title: In a Chinese Leader’s Death, Mourning for a More Hopeful Time

title: Prediction Firms Are Flagging Insider Traders. Many Will Not Face Charges.
